title: AWS AI Service Cards: Amazon Nova 2 Lite
paper_type_zh: 云服务模型卡与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 审查云端前沿模型的数据、反馈、运行时安全和审计边界的读者
one_line: AWS's Nova 2 Lite Service Card discloses high-level source categories, SFT/RLHF, filters, and evaluation layers but withholds records, rewards, and reproducibility artifacts.
AWS 的 Nova 2 Lite 服务卡披露了高层来源类别、SFT/RLHF、过滤和评测层，但没有公开记录、奖励或可复现制品。
why: A cloud-provider frontier disclosure baseline that separates named post-training and safety interfaces from unavailable provenance, feedback, reward, trace, and audit artifacts.
inclusion_reason: Major-cloud-provider service card naming source classes, SFT/RLHF, runtime filtering, evaluation layers, and proprietary safety-prompt counts while withholding audit-critical data and reward artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Amazon Nova 2 Lite is a managed multimodal model service accepting text, image, and video inputs and returning text completions. Its official Service Card describes service behavior, training-stage labels, safety controls, and evaluation methods, but not a reusable post-training corpus or reward implementation.

For the atlas, the problem is to separate concrete disclosure from implied completeness. AWS names curated source classes, SFT, RLHF, runtime prompt/completion filtering, human evaluation, automated benchmarks, and red teaming. The underlying records, feedback labels, rewards, provenance, and reproducibility artifacts remain unavailable, so this entry is a frontier-report disclosure ledger rather than a data release.

Amazon Nova 2 Lite 是一项托管式多模态模型服务，接收文本、图像和视频输入并返回文本 completion。官方 Service Card 说明了服务行为、训练阶段名称、安全控制和评测方法，但没有给出可复用的后训练语料或奖励实现。

对本图谱而言，核心问题是区分具体披露与表面上的完整性。AWS 点名了经策划的来源类别、SFT、RLHF、运行时提示/输出过滤、人工评估、自动基准和红队，但底层记录、反馈标签、奖励、溯源与复现工件仍不可得。因此，本条目是前沿报告披露账本，而不是数据发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report exposes two different objects. The deployment object is a prompt—possibly multimodal and optionally augmented for features such as Web Grounding—followed by a generated completion after input and output filtering. The model can use a one-million-token context and offers low, medium, or high extended-thinking effort; step-by-step reasoning is displayed as [REDACTED], although reasoningContent blocks indicate that thinking was used.

The training disclosure is much coarser: curated licensed/proprietary, open-source, and public data; weight adjustment through SFT and RLHF; and tuned privacy, profanity, and safety filters. It does not disclose a record schema, preference object, reward model, calibration, rollout allocation, or optimizer. The runtime reasoning interface therefore must not be mistaken for released reasoning traces.

报告公开了两类不同对象。部署对象是一个可包含多模态内容、并可为 Web Grounding 等功能而增强的 prompt；系统经过输入和输出过滤后返回 completion。模型支持一百万 token 上下文，并提供 low、medium、high 三档 extended thinking；逐步推理显示为 [REDACTED]，但 reasoningContent block 可表明推理已启用。

训练披露则粗粒度得多：经策划的许可/专有、开源和公开数据，经 SFT 与 RLHF 调整权重，以及经过调节的隐私、粗俗内容和安全过滤器。报告未披露记录模式、偏好对象、奖励模型、校准、rollout 分配或优化器。因此，运行时推理接口不能被误当作已发布推理轨迹。

title: Method
方法
html:
At runtime, Bedrock receives a prompt, filters it, may augment it for requested services, generates a completion, filters the output, and returns the result. The Service Card describes pretraining on curated source classes, followed by SFT and RLHF to align behavior with design goals and separate tuning of safety filters. The exact architecture, checkpoints, feedback source, pair format, reward, objectives, and optimization schedule are unknown.

Development testing uses public and proprietary automated benchmarks, proxy use cases, proprietary human-evaluation prompts rated by multiple people on factors such as quality, verbosity, and formatting, automated and manual red teaming, and third-party specialist review. These are evaluation interfaces, not confirmed training records. Training filters, mixture weights, quantities, rights, splits, decontamination, sampling temperatures, rollout counts, extended-thinking budget allocation, and candidate attrition are undisclosed.

运行时，Bedrock 接收 prompt，先过滤输入，可按请求为特定服务增强上下文，再生成 completion、过滤输出并返回结果。Service Card 描述了在经策划来源类别上的预训练，随后通过 SFT 与 RLHF 使行为对齐设计目标，并单独调节安全过滤器。具体架构、检查点、反馈来源、偏好对格式、奖励、目标函数和优化日程均为 unknown。

开发测试使用公开和专有自动基准、预期用例代理、由多人按质量、冗长度和格式等因素评定的专有人工评测提示、自动和人工红队，以及第三方专业评估。这些是评测接口，不是已确认的训练记录。训练过滤、混合权重、数量、权利、划分、去污染、采样温度、rollout 数量、extended-thinking 预算分配和候选淘汰情况均未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official AWS Service Card PDF directly supports the multimodal I/O, one-million-token context, three extended-thinking effort levels, redacted reasoning display, source classes, SFT/RLHF, runtime filtering, and layered evaluation methodology. The official Bedrock model page confirms the service identity.

The card reports more than 98% safe responses on a proprietary 6.4K-prompt harmfulness set and more than 95% on a proprietary 8.5K-prompt toxicity set. These are provider-reported, unreleased evaluation results for the end-to-end system. They do not establish the quality of training examples, feedback labels, reward calibration, decontamination, or reproducibility.

官方 AWS Service Card PDF直接支持多模态 I/O、一百万 token 上下文、三档 extended-thinking effort、被删节的推理显示、来源类别、SFT/RLHF、运行时过滤和分层评测方法。官方 Bedrock 模型页确认了服务身份。

服务卡报告：在一个专有的 6.4K 条有害提示集上，安全响应超过 98%；在一个专有的 8.5K 条毒性提示集上，安全响应超过 95%。这些是提供商报告、但未发布的端到端系统评测结果，不能证明训练样本质量、反馈标签、奖励校准、去污染或可复现性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The atlas value is the disclosure boundary created by placing model-development controls and deployment controls side by side. Nova 2 Lite's card names source classes, SFT/RLHF, prompt augmentation, input/output filtering, hidden extended thinking, automated assessment, human judgment, and red teaming, while leaving the record-level pipeline closed.

This is not evidence of a new reusable dataset, a disclosed preference-learning algorithm, or transparent chain-of-thought supervision. The useful comparison is with other frontier reports: Nova 2 Lite exposes a relatively detailed service interface and evaluation stack, yet its training mixture, reward contract, and audit lineage remain unknown.

对本图谱而言，价值来自把模型开发控制和部署控制并列后形成的披露边界。Nova 2 Lite 的服务卡点名来源类别、SFT/RLHF、prompt 增强、输入/输出过滤、隐藏的 extended thinking、自动评估、人工判断和红队，同时仍保持记录级流水线封闭。

这不是新型可复用数据集、已披露偏好学习算法或透明思维链监督的证据。真正有用的是与其他前沿报告比较：Nova 2 Lite 公开了相对详细的服务接口和评测栈，但训练混合、奖励契约和审计谱系仍为 unknown。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report does not release training or evaluation records, source manifests, mixture weights, quantities, revisions, source-level rights, SFT examples, preference pairs, annotator instructions, reward code, verifier calibration, rollout pools, rejected candidates, optimizer settings, checkpoints, train/test allocation, or decontamination evidence. Proprietary evaluation prompts, labels, rubrics, and red-team transcripts are unavailable.

Extended-thinking content is redacted, so customers cannot inspect the reasoning tokens they are billed for; the reported reasoning effort levels are interfaces rather than documented compute allocations. Web, tool, and customer workflows add changing external state. Reported safety percentages measure selected proprietary evaluations and should not be generalized to all use cases or treated as training-data quality evidence.

报告没有发布训练或评测记录、来源清单、混合权重、数量、版本、逐来源权利、SFT 样本、偏好对、标注者指引、奖励代码、验证器校准、rollout pool、被拒候选、优化器设置、检查点、训练/测试分配或去污染证据。专有评测提示、标签、rubric 和红队转录也不可得。

Extended-thinking 内容被删节，客户无法检查其付费的推理 token；报告中的推理强度档位只是接口，并非已记录的计算分配。Web、工具和客户工作流还会引入变化的外部状态。所报告的安全比例只衡量特定专有评测，不能泛化到所有用例，也不能当作训练数据质量证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, this Card helps separate four commonly conflated layers: hidden training records, named post-training stages, deployed reasoning/tool interfaces, and evaluation evidence. It is especially useful when comparing models that advertise test-time reasoning but do not expose their reasoning traces or post-training data.

An audit derived from this Card should request source and rights manifests, SFT/preference schemas, reward and calibration details, rollout and thinking-budget accounting, filter behavior, evaluation splits, decontamination, and versioned release logs. The card can guide disclosure comparison and risk review; it cannot reproduce training or validate data quality.

对 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger 而言，本 Card 有助于区分四个常被混合的层次：隐藏训练记录、已命名后训练阶段、部署时推理/工具接口，以及评测证据。它尤其适合比较那些宣传测试时推理、却不公开推理轨迹或后训练数据的模型。

基于本 Card 的审计应要求来源与权利清单、SFT/偏好模式、奖励和校准细节、rollout 与推理预算核算、过滤器行为、评测划分、去污染和版本化发布日志。本卡可以指导披露比较和风险审查，但不能复现训练或验证数据质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the deployed prompt/completion flow separate from the undisclosed post-training record schema.
  • Treat reasoningContent and [REDACTED] as runtime interface facts, not released reasoning traces.
  • Keep SFT/RLHF labels separate from a disclosed preference, reward, or verifier contract.
  • Read the 6.4K and 8.5K safety sets as unreleased evaluation claims, not data-quality proof.

• 将部署时的 prompt/completion 流程与未披露的后训练记录模式分开。
  • 将 reasoningContent 和 [REDACTED] 视为运行时接口事实，而不是已发布推理轨迹。
  • 将 SFT/RLHF 标签与已披露的偏好、奖励或验证器契约区分开。
  • 将 6.4K 和 8.5K 安全集视为未发布评测主张，而不是数据质量证明。
